p: daughters of Moab: With the women.
joined himself unto Baalpeor: Worshipped the idol of the Moabites, which was in the hill Peor.
against the sun: Openly in the sight of all.
men that were joined unto Baalpeor: Let him execute those that are under his charge.
who were weeping before the door: Repenting that they had offended God.
was zealous for my sake among: He was zealous to maintain my glory.
atonement for the children of Israel: He has pacified God's wrath.
wiles: Causing you to commit both corporal and spiritual fornication by Balaam's counsel, Nu 31:16, Re 2:14.
